description: Issue #815: a program that fails the check does not run (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`) — "no instruction executes, no trace event is emitted". Measured before this slice, this program printed 1 and 3 while the middle statement vanished with no diagnostic at all, which is the defect saga #811 exists to remove: a wrong program that looks right. The whole program is now refused, and the learner is told which name OpenLogo does not know.
